note: Lassen NF campground in a stand of tall pines above the south shore of Eagle Lake, set back from the shoreline through forest, on the paved trail linking the recreation area. Paved spurs (site 50 gravel); two 30-amp electric-and-water sites and two small group sites. The marina, about a mile away, has a store, gas, propane, showers, laundry and the boat launch; the nearest dump station is about 2.5 mi away ($10). --Claude
